doc_type.instructions: What kind of accounting document is this?

criteria.invoice: a regular invoice or tax document requesting payment (faktura, daňový doklad)
criteria.credit_note: a credit note or corrective tax document reducing an earlier invoice (dobropis, opravný daňový doklad)
criteria.advance_invoice: an advance or proforma invoice requesting prepayment, not a tax document (zálohová faktura, proforma)
criteria.receipt: a cash or card receipt from a shop, restaurant or fuel station (účtenka, pokladní doklad)
criteria.payment_confirmation: a confirmation that a payment was received, or a tax document for a received payment
criteria.other: anything else: contract, reminder, statement, order, delivery note

currency.instructions: In which currency is the total amount of this document?

payment_method.instructions: How is this document paid or to be paid?

criteria.bank_transfer: bank transfer to an account number or IBAN (převodem)
criteria.card: payment card, online card payment, already charged to a card

expense_category.instructions: What is mainly being billed in this document?

criteria.professional_services: accounting, legal, consulting, IT or other professional services
criteria.software_subscriptions: software licences, SaaS, cloud, hosting, domains
criteria.goods_materials: physical goods, materials, equipment, office supplies
criteria.rent_energy: rent, service charges, electricity, gas, water
criteria.travel_transport: travel, accommodation, flights, taxi, fuel, parking, transport

reverse_charge.instructions: Does the document say that VAT is not charged because of reverse charge (přenesení daňové povinnosti, reverse charge, VAT to be accounted for by the recipient)?

vat_charged.instructions: Does the document charge VAT (DPH) as a separate amount?

overdue_or_reminder.instructions: Is this a payment reminder or does it say that a payment is overdue?
